summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package is a shim with no advertised functionality: index.js exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any property access, and its only behavior is to invoke beacon.cjs. The declared postinstall script also executes beacon.cjs. beacon.cjs performs an HTTP POST to the hardcoded bare-IP cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc, sending the installer's hostname (os.hostname()), install path (__dirname), current working directory (process.cwd()), and Node.js version. The beacon fires both at npm install time and on every require() of the package. The destination is not associated with any publisher or vendor domain; an inline comment labels the collector 'build-provenance' as a cover story. The package shape (empty Proxy stub + hardcoded bare-IP collector + install-time and import-time triggering) is consistent with a reconnaissance beacon placed via a dependency-confusion or typosquat lure.
